title: Date parsing: numeric-string seconds and milliseconds are mishandled; garbage dates stored
persona: Trial user, day 7 (QA-PAYWALL, signed webhooks + forged sl_session cookie)
steps: membership.canceled status canceled with renewal_period_end = "1797830405" (string of unix seconds, uid qa_tri_d_numstr) -> access lost immediately although 30 days remain
Same with ms number 1797830405645 (qa_tri_d_ms) -> Account shows renews 12/23/58940
expected: Unix seconds (number or numeric string) and ISO both give the right date; ms or invalid values are rejected or normalised.
actual: Only a JS number is treated as seconds; strings are stored as-is; ms is multiplied by 1000 again. Plain number seconds and ISO work (qa_tri_d_sec, isoNoTZ).
